form.label: System Health
form.description: Platform capacity and whether the detection content is actually running. The Monitoring Console covers most of this, but an app-local view means analysts see it without a separate role grant, and the scheduler panel at the bottom answers the question the Monitoring Console does not: are the rules executing, or quietly being skipped?

search.query: index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=thruput name=index_thruput | timechart span=1m avg(kbps) AS kbps | stats avg(kbps) AS kbps | eval kbps = round(kbps, 2)
index=_internal source=*license_usage.log type=Usage | stats sum(b) AS bytes | eval pct = round(bytes / 1024 / 1024 / 1024 / 5 * 100, 1) | fields pct

index=_internal source=*metrics.log group=search_concurrency | timechart span=1m max(active_hist_searches) AS historical, max(active_realtime_searches) AS realtime | stats max(historical) AS h, max(realtime) AS r | eval total = h + r | fields total
| dbinspect index=linux OR index=windows OR index=linux_audit OR index=windows_audit | stats sum(sizeOnDiskMB) AS mb | eval gb = round(mb / 1024, 2) | fields gb
index=_introspection component=Hostwide | timechart span=5m avg(data.cpu_system_pct) AS "System CPU %", avg(data.cpu_user_pct) AS "User CPU %"

index=_introspection component=PerProcess | eval proc = case( like(data.process, "splunkd%"), "splunkd server", like(data.process, "python%"), "search", like(data.process, "splunk-web%"), "Splunk Web", true(), "other") | stats avg(data.pct_cpu) AS cpu BY proc | sort - cpu
index=_introspection component=Hostwide | timechart span=5m avg(data.mem_used) AS "Memory used (MB)"

index=_introspection component=PerProcess | eval proc = case( like(data.process, "splunkd%"), "splunkd server", like(data.process, "python%"), "search", like(data.process, "splunk-web%"), "Splunk Web", true(), "other") | stats avg(data.mem_used) AS mem BY proc | sort - mem

| rest /services/data/indexes | search title IN ("linux","linux_audit","windows","windows_audit","sysmon","dns_logs","web_logs","db_input","siem_summary") | eval size_gb = round(currentDBSizeMB / 1024, 2), max_size_gb = round(maxTotalDataSizeMB / 1024, 2), pct_full = round(currentDBSizeMB / maxTotalDataSizeMB * 100, 1), retention_days= round(frozenTimePeriodInSecs / 86400, 0), oldest_event = strftime(minTime, "%F %T"), newest_event = strftime(maxTime, "%F %T") | table title, totalEventCount, size_gb, max_size_gb, pct_full, retention_days, oldest_event, newest_event | rename title AS "Index", totalEventCount AS "Events", size_gb AS "Size (GB)", max_size_gb AS "Max (GB)", pct_full AS "% full", retention_days AS "Retention (days)", oldest_event AS "Oldest event", newest_event AS "Newest event" | sort - "Size (GB)"

index=_internal sourcetype=scheduler app=siem_core | stats count AS runs, count(eval(status="success")) AS succeeded, count(eval(status="skipped")) AS skipped, count(eval(status="continued")) AS deferred, avg(run_time) AS avg_runtime, latest(_time) AS last_run BY savedsearch_name | eval avg_runtime = round(avg_runtime, 2), last_run = strftime(last_run, "%F %T"), health = case(skipped > 0, "SKIPPING", runs = 0, "NEVER RAN", true(), "healthy") | sort health, savedsearch_name | rename savedsearch_name AS "Detection rule", runs AS "Runs", succeeded AS "Succeeded", skipped AS "Skipped", deferred AS "Deferred", avg_runtime AS "Avg runtime (s)", last_run AS "Last run", health AS "Health"
